source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Script require MetricReports plus MetricReportDefinitions, while the Master Procedure queries only MetricReportDefinitions. The missing MetricReports operation is material coverage, so the mismatch must remain visible even though both checks are safely automatable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended paired scope is named explicitly by Items and Script and can be reconciled without a destructive or undefined action; schemas and empty-state policy are normal package inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents a definitions-only request from passing a paired reports/definitions title, while adding complete, paginated and relationship-aware evidence instead of two unqualified ID lists.
independent_technical_reasoning: A MetricReportDefinition describes what may be sampled and how, while a MetricReport is an instance containing or representing resulting readings; their populations need not be equal. Therefore the review cannot require a report for every definition or fail an empty reports collection without an approved generation policy. Referential validation must use the firmware schema's actual links and bounded pagination, not infer relationships from similar IDs. This case remains inventory-oriented; generating a report belongs to the distinct SubmitTestMetricReport case.
